title.en: Responsible Data Science: Privacy, Fairness and Documentation
title.ar: علم البيانات المسؤول: الخصوصية والإنصاف والتوثيق

tagline: REPLACE: one line under the title: what participants can do after the course
description: Participants take the synthetic applicant data and eligibility-screening model of Yusr Housing Support Fund, a fictional public fund, through the checks a release needs: they measure re-identification risk and de-identify the table, publish differentially private counts under a budget, test a synthetic extract for leakage, audit subgroup errors against the bias types in SDAIA's AI Bias Reference Guide, and write the datasheet, model card and impact assessment a reviewer needs. Calibration and explanation are DS-305.
audience: Practitioners. Data scientists and analysts who have completed the level 200 set or can show equivalent work: an analysis they framed, carried out and explained to a stakeholder.
prerequisites: DS-204 Machine Learning for Tabular Data: Baselines and Validation
DS-207 Responsible Data Practice and Conduct in Analytical Work
Trains and evaluates a classifier in Python
Computes error rates and confidence intervals for proportions

outcomes.text: Distinguish pseudonymisation, de-identification, aggregation, synthetic data and differential privacy by the guarantee and cost of each, given five described data releases
outcomes.evidence: a decision table naming the fitting control and the residual risk for each

outcomes.text: Measure re-identification risk from quasi-identifiers and reduce it while tracking analytic utility, given 60,000 synthetic applicant records and a linkable external file
outcomes.evidence: unique records, linkage success and three key statistics before and after treatment

outcomes.text: Compute differentially private counts and means and state the accuracy cost of a privacy budget, given three candidate budgets
outcomes.evidence: error-against-budget curves and a recommended setting

outcomes.text: Test a synthetic extract for analytic utility and membership-inference leakage, given a generator trained on the applicant table
outcomes.evidence: a utility and leakage report with a release recommendation

outcomes.text: Audit a screening model for subgroup disparities, choose fairness criteria that fit the decision and evaluate two mitigations, given a scored test set with protected and intersectional attributes
outcomes.evidence: an audit report with disaggregated error rates, intervals and a recommendation

outcomes.text: Build the datasheet, model card and impact assessment a reviewer needs to judge and rerun a release, given the participant's capstone release
outcomes.evidence: a pack that a peer reruns and challenges, with a likelihood and impact score for each risk
